threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the nearest Tube station instead of just hopping on the Overground from Dalston Junction.
Caught a woman knitting a scarf on the 37 last night. She had a little bag of wool and seemed completely unfazed by the drunk crowd.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a kid proudly showing off their new skateboard at the Grafitti wall, totally unbothered by the world around them. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice that even during a BVG strike, people still find a way to get around? A bike share and an umbrella usually do the trick.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they know that the taco stand at 24th and Valencia is always better after a late-night bar crawl. Only tourists go for the trendy spots.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today where the driver stopped to let a saxophonist play a solo. Only in SF would a jam session break out mid-commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the bars here close at 2 AM. Nah, in Gràcia, the real night just starts heating up around 3 AM with locals gathering for xampanyet.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They linger way too long at the metro ticket machines, still figuring out the options instead of just tapping their cards.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still navigate by landmarks instead of bus stops. Everyone knows 'the big Tesco' isn’t a valid direction.
Caught the N68 last night; a guy was passionately detailing his conspiracy theory about the old market being haunted. Quite the ride!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a guy playing accordion on the U7, while a couple argued over who ran the best döner shop in the area.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Ever notice the street art on the U-Bahn trains? It’s like a moving gallery that changes daily. You won’t find that in any other city.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they ignore the BART delays; they’ve got a backup plan for getting across town that doesn’t involve waiting in line.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in the Tenderloin get off the 47, pop a wheely on his bike, then hug a streetlight like it was his long-lost friend. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all cats are stray here, but the neighbourhood's full of proud owners who let their pets roam freely. It's not a cat commune!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still baffled by the 'dibus' signs in the metro, squinting at the map while everyone else walks past like pros.
